description: Find published ecommerce tools by text, seller task, platform, pricing type and delivery kind. Filters combine with AND. Returns up to 20 concise matches with EcomPick source links and last checked dates. Any-store tools are included for a platform but are not implied to have native integrations.

kind.description: Delivery kind: SaaS, AI tool, MCP, Skill, Browser extension, API.

platform.description: Platform ID or name from list_platforms, e.g. shopify.

pricing.description: Pricing label: Free, Free plan, Free trial, Paid. Legacy pricing filter aliases remain accepted.

query.description: Text to match in tool names and English/Chinese taglines.

task.description: Task ID or name from list_tasks, e.g. product-images.

name: search_tools
